Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed classroom and facility data, with 175 learning spaces detailed (81 permanent, 94 portable). Robust condition assessment with 305 projects identified, prioritized, and linked to capital planning; includes detailed site profiles and multiple data sources (pages 28-56, Exhibits B and C).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed, long-term enrollment projections using multiple methodologies with demographic and housing data integration. Capacity utilization analyzed by site and classroom type with clear connection to facility actions and surplus portable classrooms identified (pages 7-33).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational specifications are a core organizing principle, with detailed discussion of 21st century teaching needs, personalization, collaboration, technology integration, and flexible learning spaces. Facility projects are directly linked to educational goals and program needs (pages 34-43).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with references to gardens, outdoor classrooms, shade structures, and site-specific greening strategies. Some districtwide strategies mentioned but not fully detailed or framed as climate resilience (pages 42-43).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related concerns such as mold mitigation and energy efficiency but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive resilience strategies across multiple climate impacts (e.g., heat, floods, wildfires).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Discusses energy efficiency projects including HVAC upgrades, lighting, and solar photovoltaic systems. Mentions battery backup and emergency generators but lacks comprehensive district-wide energy resilience plan or detailed state compliance strategy (pages 39-44, 88).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents a detailed financial plan including Measure L bond authorization, state funding eligibility, Proposition 39 energy funding, and multiple other funding sources. Includes prioritization framework, cost estimates, and long-term financial sustainability considerations (pages 57-66).
